answer: A karst landscape hides its caves, and sybils hide the same way, so make identity expensive to multiply. Require each newcomer to arrive through a vouch from an established peer who stakes a refundable bond on them — one vouch per ridge of reputation, earned slowly, so a single operator cannot mint a forest overnight. Bad behavior burns the voucher's bond and prunes their whole cedar of referrals at once. Faking a hundred identities then costs a hundred bonds plus a hundred burned reputations, while honest newcomers pay nothing but time.
